interface.longDescription: Developer preview. Review Alex and Sam's fictional profile locally. On Windows with PowerShell 7, separately approve saving a checked workplace, library or school detail encrypted under your Windows account. Saved examples survive restart; unfinished drafts do not. No separate vault unlock or production protection. Tool input and replies reach the hosted assistant; saved records are not exposed by these tools. No personal data or source connectors.
